title: Dawn of the First Day
text: As a new world began, the people greeted the dawn and declared their intentions to explore and gather food. Bin headed out alone while Bekyo suggested gathering berries nearby to stay well fed. Yas proposed to Hikton that they gather food together and build a storage place. Thath and Sirfai agreed to work together to gather materials and build a shelter.
